title: Normalized coefficient comparison for the concrete Weil stage categories
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum, a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $X_0$ and its geometric fibre $X$, and the finite and common PBC Weil categories of [def-wf-weil-category]. Let $S$ be the normalized coefficient-comparison system of [lem-fd-rational-coefficient-category-comparison]. On the SF Weil categories of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], define $J_E$ by applying the finite coefficient equivalence with the comparison from completed pullback to exact scheme-isomorphism transport; this comparison is uniquely fixed by its equation with the completion unit and ordinary derived transport. Its rational version is fixed on every localized integral arrow. Define the finite SF stage inclusion $i_E$, SF scalar functor $T^s_h$ and transition $t^s_h:T^s_hi_L\cong i_E$ using the recorded pullback/scalar comparison and underlying common-stage maps. Define $j_h:J_ET^p_h\cong T^s_hJ_L$ to have the prescribed normalized coefficient scalar map on carriers. A ConstantTwistWeilComparison is an equivalence $J$ from SF common-stage Weil pairs to PBC common-stage Weil pairs, together with natural isomorphisms $a_E:i_EJ\cong J_E\iota_E$. Require for every $h:E\subseteq L$ and finite SF Weil pair $K$ the transition square
$$J(t^s_{h,K})\,a_{E,K}=a_{L,T^s_hK}\,\iota_L(j_{h,K}^{-1})\,t^p_{h,J_EK},$$
where $t^p_h:T^p_h\iota_L\cong\iota_E$ is the specified PBC transition, and products are written in order of application. The equation includes equal stages; successive extensions use the specified scalar associators. These data are the normalized common-stage presentation induced by $S$, not independent choices of stage identifications. Define the interface record with this equation and its finite functors, scalar maps and transition maps; its existence is the common-stage descent obligation.
